key_path: Create/sign in to a Microsoft account
Create an Azure free account: phone verification (SMS/call) + credit/debit card identity check (temporary ~$1 hold; virtual/prepaid cards rejected), accept agreement
`az group create` then `az cognitiveservices account create --kind OpenAI` (or a Foundry/AIServices resource) in a supported region
`az cognitiveservices account deployment create` to deploy a model (e.g. a GPT model) with SKU/capacity. Quota may need a request for some models
`az cognitiveservices account keys list` to get key1/key2 + endpoint (or use keyless Entra ID via DefaultAzureCredential, which Microsoft recommends)
human_gates_notes: The card + phone identity check is unavoidable for a new subscription. MFA is now enforced for Azure portal/CLI sign-in. The old Azure OpenAI access-request form is no longer needed for standard models, but some models/regions still have quota or limited-access approval.

agent_native_auth.cli_login: yes. `az login` browser/device-code flow; `azd auth login`
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no for the Azure MCP Server (local, uses Azure CLI/Entra credentials). The MS Learn docs MCP needs no auth
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mint_keys: yes. Everything is ARM/CLI-scriptable: create resource, deploy model, list/regenerate keys
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: partial. Resource-level keys are all-powerful for that resource; fine-grained scoping via Entra RBAC (Cognitive Services OpenAI User) and managed identity
agent_native_auth.sandbox_test_credentials: no separate sandbox. Free account credit ($200/30 days) acts as one
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes. Free account credit + some always-free services; Azure OpenAI is pay-as-you-go against credit

docs_mcp.transport: Streamable HTTP (protocol 2025-06-18, verified by initialize probe)

product_mcp_local.package: npx -y @azure/mcp@latest server start (also NuGet/.NET tool, PyPI via uvx, MCPB)
product_mcp_local.scope: broad Azure services incl. Foundry/AI resources

mcp.product_mcp_remote: Self-host the Azure MCP Server on Azure Container Apps via azd templates for Foundry/Copilot Studio. Microsoft-hosted remote MCPs exist for specific services (e.g. Azure DevOps remote MCP, public preview Mar 2026)
mcp.one_click_install: yes. VS Code/VS Code Insiders deep-link install buttons, Visual Studio 2026, IntelliJ, Eclipse, and Claude Code `/plugin install azure@claude-plugins-official`

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes. MS Learn serves markdown with ?accept=text/markdown / Accept: text/markdown
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes. Azure REST API specs (github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs), including the Azure OpenAI inference spec
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: yes. Azure MCP Server get-started + Learn MCP docs

score_justification: Fully CLI-scriptable end to end (az login > create > deploy > keys) with first-party MCPs and one-click IDE installs, but card + phone identity checks, MFA, a deploy-a-model step and quota make zero-to-call slower than Gemini.
best_practice: Keyless Entra ID auth is the recommended default, and the Azure MCP ships as a first-party Claude Code plugin and IDE extensions
biggest_gap: No llms.txt, a heavy signup gate (card + phone), and a 'deploy a model before you can call it' step that agents often miss
